- New `late_whitewash` strategy (honest until the calibration window ends, then whitewashes). Calibration-only minority trust is blind to it.
- New `stealth.rolling_minority_trust_market`: block-wise, decayed minority-label PTS trust with liquidity scaling. Brier drops 43% (lie prob 0.5) and 79% (lie prob 1.0) vs. plain/frozen.
- 4 new tests (61 total pass), experiment section, README write-up with caveats and remaining open items.
